name: kms
description: Vivantel KMS (Knowledge Management System): everyday development skills for Claude Code. Get started fast with quickstart, brainstorm approaches to a problem, or rigorously clarify a plan through interrogation and turn one into durable knowledge artifacts and a standalone roadmap; bootstrap and steward a project's fact/decision/guardrail system across sessions, lint it for structural rot, query it for answers with citations, onboard a role from it, or plan a refactor against it; attribute commits and PRs to their underlying intent, and generate changelogs from commit history.
